Proves AR-6's `notIn` operator on a `decimal` field (AR-7), with SEM-2's null-inclusion rule applying to the set-negative form. AG Grid's Set Filter has no exclude-mode wire shape, so this fixture uses the `customFilters` (OQ-11) extension point, as 036 and 038 do. The values are numeric strings (AR-7), so a host binds the set as `text[]`; per SQL-4 Postgres casts the array, `"unit_cost" <> ALL($1::numeric[])`, because `numeric = text` does not exist (Bug #2304). Members compare as numbers, so `19.990` equals `19.99` and `5.50` equals `5.5` (XEQ-3). Mongo carries `$numberDecimal` values; Search a plain number (the documented precision-limited divergence of 046).
